annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a PRIORITY frame may be sent as the first frame of a client-initiated request stream, thereby creating a dependency on an existing element (identified by a Prioritized ID or Dependency ID as defined in the preceding clause). The wording does not permit multiple materially different implementation behaviours, nor does it omit any constraint that would change the operational interpretation.
